about: Every place NoitaCraft touches Magicraft (BepInEx 5 + Harmony). Each row generates one patch registration.

columns.target: Magicraft type.method (decompiled Assembly-CSharp); for a transpiler, Type|code it rewrites
columns.kind: prefix | postfix | transpiler | api (Unity API override, no patch)

rows.purpose: add every Noita spell and modifier as its own Magicraft spell (own id and ability type, Noita's numbers, 3 levels) plus a hidden explosion row; the drop pool, shops, tooltips and ECS configs all read this table

build each spawn as Magicraft does, then give Noita spells their own entity and Noita's bounces, piercing, wall rules, teleport, black hole pull and damage type, and apply Noita modifiers to the next projectile
Noita modifiers cost their Noita mana (and copies cost again); Magicraft charges enhancements nothing
register Spell_<newBase> (copy of the plain bullet Spell_1001) and Spell_1890 (a still bullet scaled to the explosion radius, for Noita's explosions), with Magicraft's meshes switched off
every frame: Noita's bounce energy, air friction or acceleration, low-speed and spent-projectile end, explosions on death, and Noita's look and sounds
remove Magicraft's bounce effect where a Noita projectile bounced (Noita's sparks are drawn there)
append Mina's Noita wands
append Mina's set
add names/descriptions in every Magicraft language Noita has
serve Noita icons for Textures/SpellIcons/noita_* and Textures/WandIcons/noita_*
Mina is always unlocked
keep Mina's set out of the save file (restored right after) so removing the mod never breaks a save
put Mina's set back in memory after saving
don't record Noita spells/wands in the save's gallery
show Mina's Noita sprite on her set card
Mina unlocked in the picked save slot, and her pick restored from NoitaCraft's own file
during a Melty test run nothing is written to the player's saves (also SaveWorldDataBackup, SaveBuildDatas and the other DataMgr save methods)
test mode: notice when a Noita spell is fired
during a Melty test only, Magicraft keeps running when its window is behind others (it sets Application.runInBackground = false at the main menu)

drop Magicraft's SE_Spell<id> requests for Noita spells (Noita's sounds play); a finalizer clears the sound queue if a missing sound throws, which otherwise repeats every frame and crashes the spell systems
in a Melty test only, the game aims where the test points instead of the real cursor
when Mina's set is picked, the player is drawn as Mina (Noita frames) instead of the Spine wizard
